title: TW3TTER
tagline: This will be aTwitter clone converted to web3 using various protocols.
description: This project is cloning Twitter functionality but also adding in Web3 functionality. Aiming to implement DeFi, Information and NFT creation into the dapp. We want to bring in the ability to have VIdeo streaming and storage features from Web3 protocols such as LivePeer, Lens and IPFS.
how_its_made: This project will be using Next JS, TailwindCSS, React Native, Hardhat, Solidity and the various web3 protocols form the hackathon aiming to demonstrate information exchange, NFT creation and trade, DEFi and storage features all from web3 protocols. Some of the protocols are LENS, LivePeer, Chainlink, Polygon and IPFS.
